import sys, os
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
rc = R24.rc; X = 72
fleet = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X, 290), (310, 'Date:', True, X, 290)]
for head in ('For and on behalf of the Recipient', None, 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.'):
  for recital in ('parsed', 'none'):
    own = ([(340, head, False, 340)] if head else []) + [(370, 'Signature:', False, 340), (382, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, 340), (394, 'Title: CEO', False, 340)]
    pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS[recital]), fleet + own])
    pat = [dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)]
    with patch('httpx.Client.send', Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))):
        r = placement.place(pdf, pat, model_client=Mock())
    print(head, recital, '|', r['status'], [(f['type'], f['evidence']['line'], f['confidence'], f['evidence'].get('labels') or f['evidence'].get('identity')) for f in r['fields']], r['assignments'])
# also: sender's own block not present at all - does Pat go on Fleet's line in a plain doc with Pat's block missing?
pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), fleet])
with patch('httpx.Client.send', Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))):
    r = placement.place(pdf, [dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)], model_client=Mock())
print('fleet block only |', r['status'], [(f['type'], f['evidence']['line'], f['confidence']) for f in r['fields']], r['assignments'])
